transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um... I'm doing okay, mostly. I just... well, I guess what really made me come in today is just a little bit of stress at work. I'm a retail buyer, which is a great job, I'm really grateful for it, I promise. But, um... lately, I just can't shake this feeling. 

It's probably nothing, but... I keep feeling like people at work, and maybe even some of the vendors I deal with, are tracking my buys. Like, really watching me. And... I don't want to sound difficult or anything, but it feels like they're messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. My supervisor actually sat me down and showed me the reports, and he says they don't prove anyone is doing that... but I just can't get the thought out of my head. 

I know it probably sounds silly, I'm sorry for even bringing it up. Does that make sense? Is that the kind of thing you needed to know?
Can you tell me more about those thoughts? Do you find that you believe these things even when others show you evidence that they aren’t true?

Um, yeah... I guess so. I mean, when my supervisor sat me down and showed me the spreadsheets, I tried to agree with him, because I didn't want to cause any trouble. He's a really good boss, honestly, and I don't want to seem ungrateful or hard to work with. But... yeah, even looking right at the numbers he pulled, in the back of my mind, I still just... I still feel like they're tracking me. 

Like, maybe they altered the reports before he printed them? Or they're doing it in a way that he can't see? I know how crazy that sounds, I really do. I'm so sorry, I don't mean to sound paranoid or like I'm accusing people of things. It's just this really strong feeling that they're messing with the launch numbers to make me look bad. 

I try to push it away, I really do, but it just sticks there. Is that... is that normal to feel sometimes when you're stressed? I hope I'm not making a bigger deal out of this than I should be.
Have you noticed any other situations lately where you've felt like people are acting against you or that things aren't as they seem?

Um... well... I mean, mostly it's just the stuff at work. I really try to get along with everyone, I promise I'm not a difficult person to be around. But... um... 

There is one other thing, and I'm really embarrassed to even mention it, because I know it sounds... well, it sounds bad. But I want to be honest with you, because I know you're just trying to help. Sometimes... like, if I'm alone in the stockroom, or if I'm driving back from a vendor meeting... I'll hear this voice. It's a man's voice. 

It sounds like he's right behind me, and he'll say things like, "Move faster, Scott," or he'll just start laughing at the items I picked for the store. And... well, when I turn around to apologize or see who it is, there's nobody there. 

I'm sure it's just my imagination acting up because I'm tired, right? Like, maybe I'm just putting too much pressure on myself to do a good job? I really hope you don't think I'm crazy for saying that. Is that... does that happen to other people when they're working too hard?
Have you ever had experiences where you believed something strongly that others didn’t, or seen or heard things that they didn’t seem to notice?

Um... besides what I just told you about the office and the stockroom? I... I don't think so. I really want to be helpful and give you all the information you need, but... no, I haven't really noticed anything else like that happening before. 

Just the feeling about the spreadsheets and... and that voice I mentioned. I'm usually a very reasonable person, I promise. I try really hard to just focus on my job and be, you know, normal. I've never been the type to imagine things or cause a fuss. So it's really just been this recent stuff with the stress. 

Is that... did I answer your question right? I hope I'm not leaving anything important out, I really am trying to give you the best answers I can.
Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something was real that others didn’t seem to notice, or seen or heard things that others around you didn’t appear to experience?

Um... oh, I'm sorry, did I not answer that right just a second ago? Or maybe I misunderstood... I really apologize if I'm not being clear enough. I'm trying my best to give you the right answers, I promise. 

But... no, honestly, other than the stuff at the office with the reports, and... and that voice in the stockroom, there really isn't anything else. I've been trying to rack my brain, because I don't want to hold anything back from you. I know you're just doing your job and trying to help me get better. I just... I really haven't noticed anything else like that happening to me. 

Am I... am I doing okay? I hope I'm not frustrating you by not having more to tell you. If there's something specific you want me to think about, I can definitely try harder.
Have you ever experienced any other unusual thoughts, sights, or sounds that other people around you didn't seem to notice?

I... um... I feel terrible, I feel like I'm making you repeat yourself and I really don't mean to be difficult. I'm so sorry. I... I promise I'm thinking really hard about it. 

But no, there's really nothing else. Just the voice I told you about, and the things with the spreadsheets at work. I've never seen anything that wasn't there, or had any other weird thoughts. I really want to give you the information you need, but I just... I don't have anything else like that to report. 

I'm sorry if I'm not being a very good patient. I'm really trying to be helpful, I promise. Is there... is there something else I should be looking out for?
Have you ever, in your life, experienced any other times where you saw, heard, or believed something that others around you didn’t seem to notice or agree with?

I... oh gosh, I feel like I'm failing a test here. I'm really, really sorry. I know you're just trying to be thorough and make sure you have all the facts. I appreciate that, I really do. You're being so patient with me.

But... no. Honestly, never in my whole life. I swear I'm not hiding anything from you. I know it's important to be completely open so you can do your job. It's just... before all this stress at the store started, I was totally fine. Just a normal guy, you know?
